status: Approved visual composition v05 assembled from original assets; editor integration not included

class_badge.visible_when: Creature and class_key is not Neutral and class_symbol exists

creature_attack.visible_when: Creature and attack is not null

weapon_attack.visible_when: Weapon and attack is not null

health.visible_when: Creature and health is not null

durability.visible_when: Weapon and durability is not null

armor.visible_when: Creature and armor is not null

validation_rules: Preserve null separately from 0; visible_when tests null, not truthiness
Unknown symbol keys produce an explicit validation error; never invent a symbol
Neutral class has no class emblem
Weapon and Spell do not receive creature health/race/time
Literary text is shown only when explicitly provided

integration_notes: Draw PNGs as alpha-over in the declared order
Apply class_rgb only to white class-tint layers, not the entire flattened frame
Use art_mask plus declared viewport to crop illustration
Render each number and each text field independently
Empty base PNGs are convenient previews with Warrior color; runtime stack supports all class colors
Only Druzhyna subtype symbol is supplied; other subtype symbols need actual data and art
